entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
I want to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought a little over two weeks ago. It's not working like I expected, and frankly, I'm really unhappy with it.
I understand your frustration. I'm happy to help process your return. Can I get your order number, please?
It's #VF12345. Hurry this up, I don't have all day.
Thank you. Let me pull that up for you. Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse. So you're looking to return that?
Yes! That's exactly what I'm trying to do! Is that a problem?

Not at all! At VeloFit, we strive for customer satisfaction. Our return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase. We want you to be happy with your VeloBand Pulse, or get your money back if you aren't. Let's get this processed.
90 days? Seriously? Well, that's good to know. I was worried since it's been 15 days already. Most places only give you, like, 10 days! So I'm well within the limit.

Yes, you are well within the timeframe. Since you're within our 90 days return policy, I've approved the return. You'll receive a pre-paid shipping label via email within the next 24 hours. Just pack up the VeloBand Pulse, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the smart watch back, we'll process your refund.
Okay, that sounds easy enough. Will the refund go back to the card I used to purchase it?

Yes, the refund will be credited back to the original payment method. Please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to appear on your statement. Is there anything else I can assist you with today regarding your VeloBand Pulse or any other VeloFit product?

No, I think that's all. Thank you for being so helpful and understanding. I appreciate you honoring the return policy, especially after 15 days. This makes me feel better about shopping with VeloFit again.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business. Have a wonderful day!
